args.summary: checkout-api version v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) began failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (~18% health check failures). SRE agent rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production. Service is now running v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west (rollback verified/rolled out). Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failures in staging before re-attempting release.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version that was healthy in production. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had a prior healthy production release.
3. **Verified**: The service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) documenting the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and recommending root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 before any re-deploy attempt. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging only, so it did not qualify as the rollback target under the policy requiring prior production health.
